notes: Single-channel active/transformer DI box. Powered exclusively by +48V phantom power delivered through the OUTPUT XLR (no dedicated power connector, no battery); front-panel blue LED indicates phantom presence. Also has non-connector controls: Instrument/Speaker input-level selector switch and a Ground Lift toggle (not physical I/O ports, so not listed). Desktop/stagebox form factor (4"W x 6.25"D x 1.75"H), not rack-mountable. No connector in this device qualifies for a bandwidth "grade" (all analog audio). Spec confirmed directly from the manufacturer's current product page (rupertneve.com/products/rndi/); this is the original single-channel RNDI, distinct from the RNDI-M (compact), RNDI-S (stereo), and RNDI-8 (8-channel rack) variants in the same product family.

ports.name: INPUT
ports.note: Hi-Z unbalanced 1/4" instrument/speaker input; switchable Instrument (2.2 MΩ, +20.5 dBu max) or Speaker mode (200 kΩ, +41 dBu max) via front-panel selector

ports.name: THRU
ports.note: Parallel (unbuffered Y-split) 1/4" thru jack, wired directly to INPUT, used to feed an amp (Instrument mode) or speaker (Speaker mode)

ports.name: OUTPUT
ports.note: Transformer-balanced mic-level XLR output; also carries +48V phantom power (4.5mA) into the unit from the connected preamp/mixer — the RNDI has no separate power inlet or battery option
